title: デビュー戦の後に・予想外のライバルズ

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Look at me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: How was that, Taiki?! That's the kind of running I'm capable of! Doesn't it make your heart skip with fear?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't speak for whether anyone's heart skipped, but I clearly felt Seeking the Pearl's amazing potential from her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All she did was put a little effort into the final stretch, and she was able to pull ahead of everyone else. At this rate, she could likely stand her own against Taiki Shuttle, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That sure was some fantastic runnin', Pearl! The way you are now…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I bet you'll be able to nab all the victories you want this year! Stick to it and do your best, all right? ♪ You'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, why are you saying it that way?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I thought you were going to run with me. You're supposed to be the big hurdle I have to conquer—or fail trying.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, about that…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right, time to take my gate exam! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yowch!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Judge
text_block_list.text: Number 14, Taiki Shuttle: disqualified.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll get it this time! I'm gonna pass for sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Again?! Whyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Judge
text_block_list.text: Number 6, Taiki Shuttle: disqualified.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Are you kidding me?! You failed the gate exam?! TWICE?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately. On top of that, I'm not in top form either, so it'll be a while till I can make my debut.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: They even said I might not be able to do it this year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wait, but that means…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hang on, then what am I supposed to do about this passion burning within me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm sorry, Pearl… Hey, I know!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll give ya a hug to make up for it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Aww, a hug! All right. I guess I forgive you, then. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wait, no! A hug won't fill the gap you'll leave behind in all my upcoming races! You cheeky thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's hard to believe, but it seems Taiki Shuttle won't be debuting for a while. We'll need to drastically adjust our expectations for the year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I guess I don't have much of a choice, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll just have to go wild and be unapologetically myself for my junior year! I'll show everyone how brightly I can shine!
choice_data_list: Sounds like a plan! Let's do it.
Sounds like a plan! Let's do it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without Taiki Shuttle, Seeking the Pearl will undoubtedly be one of the leaders of her year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So anyway, what should I run in for my next race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I already have a plan. With her strongest rival out of the picture, there's no reason not to start with G2s and move straight into G1s.
choice_data_list: Let's have you run the Daily Hai Junior Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Daily Hai Junior Stakes… That's one of the big G2 races.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sure… I can do that. That race suits me, and besides…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The spotlight's practically mine now! There's no one who can outshine me. Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Seeking the Pearl laughs joyfully, another conversation is taking place elsewhere…
Oh, right. Taiki won't be running this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That means we have a chance too, Bright. This might be a sign that hope is shining down on us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That's true. This is a very good thing for the Mejiro family. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If it's all right with you, I'd like to run against Pearl first. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sure. You can take the vanguard. Even if we're no match for her individually…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm sure the two of us can beat Pearl together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even without the speedy Taiki Shuttle in the picture, Seeking the Pearl can't let her guard down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's already a formidable racer waiting for Seeking the Pearl at her first race, the Daily Hai Junior Stakes.
